title: AlexNet
paper_title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
core_mech: 以 GPU、ReLU、dropout 和深卷积组合首次规模化训练 ImageNet 级深 CNN。
core_mech_en: First large-scale ImageNet-grade deep CNN trained end-to-end by combining dual-GPU parallelism, non-saturating ReLU activations, dropout regularization, and stacked convolutions.
output_desc: 类别概率或倒数第二层视觉特征
output_en: Closed-set class probabilities or penultimate 4096-D visual feature vector

source.title: AlexNet
notes: TorchVision is the maintained library implementation, not the original 2012 author training release. Its AlexNet definition differs from the original dual-GPU/local-response-normalization architecture; do not call it a numerical reproduction of the paper.

adapter.name: AlexNet
adapter.mechanism: Five convolution layers and three fully connected layers from torchvision; reduced classifier.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Torchvision uses its documented AlexNet variant; adaptive pooling 1x1 and classifier width 128 replace the 6x6/4096 head.

verification.title: AlexNet
